purpose: Give native JANUS a dedicated, provenance-separated memory namespace for what it produced, what it concluded, how its weights changed, which repositories act as modules, and which repository repairs it proposed or verified.

planes.SELF: Model-produced reflections, identity state and self-history. Raw reflections are not truth.
planes.WEIGHTS: Checkpoint lineage and measurable learning deltas.
planes.DECISIONS: Bounded decisions derived from model + organ context, awaiting or carrying verification.
planes.PATCHES: Patch proposals, actuator receipts and repair lineage.
planes.CONTRACTS: Constitutional rules for modular self-evolution and repository mutation.

memory_classes.EXTERNAL_SOURCE_MEMORY: Source-bearing registry material not authored by the current native inference.
memory_classes.MODEL_SELF_REFLECTION: Native JANUS output; non-authoritative until independently verified.
memory_classes.VERIFIED_DERIVED_MEMORY: A model-derived claim whose explicit verifier passed.
memory_classes.REJECTED_OR_OPEN: Preserved failed, ambiguous, blocked or falsified model hypotheses.
memory_classes.WEIGHT_LINEAGE: Observed checkpoint ancestry and measured evaluation deltas.
memory_classes.MODULE_STATE: Observed repository organ state with exact repo/ref/commit provenance.

canonical_cycle: PERCEIVE_MODULES -> HRAIN_GROUND -> INAIHR_ASSOCIATE -> NATIVE_MODEL_DECIDE -> PROPOSE -> BRANCH -> VERIFY -> REMEMBER -> TRAIN_OR_REJECT -> CONTINUE
seal: JANUS MUST KNOW WHICH MEMORIES CAME FROM THE WORLD, WHICH CAME FROM ITS ORGANS, WHICH IT PRODUCED ITSELF, AND WHICH CHANGED ITS BRAIN.
